title: Onboard CLI: generate deterministic compile signatures and publish signed performance provenance bundles
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: model onboarding lacks a deterministic, verifiable artifact that ties a model binary + compiler choices to the published performance profile. This makes rollbacks and cross-region compatibility checks brittle for complex architectures (MHA, GQA, MoE) where minor config or kernel ordering changes produce large latency regressions.

Goal: implement an onboarding CLI that emits a deterministic compile signature and packages a signed performance provenance bundle for each pinned model version. The signature will be used as the canonical 'version pin' field in the model manifest and by the routing/rollback system. The provenance bundle contains the profile matrix (latency P50/P95, memory, kernels used, batch behaviors), compiler git sha, build artifact checksums, and sampled eval traces used for quality checks.

Why unique / important: unlike prior work that focused on runtime autotuning or kernel pin lists, this ticket produces a single verifiable artifact (signature + signed bundle) that operators, the console, and the runtime can all consume to make deterministic routing, compatibility checks, and safe rollouts for MHA/GQA/MoE models.

Non-goals: replace the autotuner or change kernel heuristics. This is a production-grade artifact/metadata generator and publish flow ONLY.
acceptance_criteria: CLI command `redwood onboard generate-signature --model <path|id> --target <arch>` produces a stable 40-char hex signature for identical inputs

Produced bundle is a gzipped manifest that includes: model-fingerprint, tokenizer-hash, compiler-git-sha, kernel-list (ordered), per-route latency matrix, kv-cache-size, sample-eval-ids, and CI-check-sums
Bundle is signed with the onboarding key and verifyable via `redwood onboard verify-bundle <bundle>`
Model manifest schema is extended with `compile_signature` (string) and `profile_bundle_url` (signed URL) and validated by the onboarding service
Runtime rejects a pinned model if the signature is incompatible with the target hardware ABI (clear error and fallbacks)
End-to-end integration test: onboard small MHA/GQA/MoE sample models -> publish pin -> canary rollout -> automated telemetry checks pass in staging
Documentation and runbook added: Confluence onboarding guide + console UI support for signature display
tasks: Design compile-signature algorithm (include fields to hash and canonicalization rules)
Implement CLI command and unit tests for signature determinism
Add bundle manifest schema and sign/verify helpers
Extend model manifest validation service and API to accept `compile_signature`
Update onboarding pipeline to run perf microbenchmarks and attach measured metrics to bundle
Integrate bundle publishing to artifacts store + add signed URL lifecycle policy
Add runtime validation hook to reject incompatible signatures (soft-fallback for backcompat)
Write integration tests and canary rollout playbook
Add docs + security review for key management
comments: 2026-02-09 - Ava Martinez: Initial stubbed prototype created. Determinism test fails when layer order normalized differently across exporter backends. Need canonical layer ordering step.

2026-02-15 - Ravi Singh: Decided to include tokenizer hash and quantization flag in signature to avoid silent behavioral mismatches. Will canonicalize tokenizer by vocabulary file checksum + tokenizer config string.

2026-02-18 - Jordan Lee (PM): Please ensure the bundle contains a human-readable summary for console display (top 3 kernels used, P50/P95 for default route). Also requested stable field names for downstream parsers.

2026-02-25 - Sienna Park (Security): Reviewed signing approach. Agreed on onboarding key in KMS and GPG-style detached signature in bundle. Requires rotation plan and acute RD to update docs. Marked security_review_required = true.

2026-03-03 - Engineering review: Kernel ordering decided: (1) layer-sweep by index, (2) kernel selection by deterministic comparator (op_type, tile_size, arch), (3) hash on joined entries. This prevents nondeterminism from set iteration in emitter.
2026-03-07 - QA: Added integrated perf harness to run 5 warmup + 50 sample runs for each microbenchmark in the bundle. Need to ensure CI tolerances are generous for nightlies.
2026-03-10 - Ravi Singh: MVP CLI merged to feature branch. PR: /runtime/pull/2145. Next: add runtime validation hook and end-to-end canary job.
Follow-ups: add signed provenance viewer in Console (PM ticket created), and add heuristics for automatic rollback thresholds in the rollout engine.
